sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.archiveRows: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment set archived = true where custom_field_id = :fieldId
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getOne: select cfg.*, ot.object_type, et.event_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfot.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId", cfot.show_on_insert as "showOnInsert" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id left join flow.event_type et on et.id = cfg.event_type_id where cfg.id = :id

SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getCustomFiel: select cfga.*, cfg.group_name, cf.field_name, cf.company_data_type_id, cf.date_created, cf.created_by_id, cf.modified_by_id, cf.date_modified from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id where cfg.id = :groupId and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true order by cfga.field_order, cf.field_name
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getEventTypes: select sft.id, sft.field_type, sft.required_data_type_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fields))) FROM ( select cf.id, cf.field_name as "fieldName", sft.id as "scheduleFieldTypeId", sft.id as "fieldOrder" from flow.custom_field cf inner join flow.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfot.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id inner join flow.company_data_type cdt on cdt.id = cf.company_data_type_id left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id where cf.company_id = :companyId and ot.flow_type_id = 2 and cf.archived is not true and cdt.data_type_id = sft.required_data_type_id and case when cf.company_system_list_id is not null then csl.schedulable is true else 1=1 end order by cf.field_name ) fields), '[]') as availableCustomFields from flow.schedule_field_type sft where sft.archived is not true order by sft.id
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getAvailableC: select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfot.company_object_type_id from flow.custom_field_object_type cfot inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfot.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfot.company_object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfot.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true except select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfg.company_object_type_id from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.company_object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true and cfg.archived is not true order by field_name
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getAvailableN: select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfot.company_object_type_id from flow.custom_field_object_type cfot inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfot.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfot.company_object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfot.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true except select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfg.company_object_type_id from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.company_object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfg.process_step_id = :processStepId and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true order by field_name
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getCustomFiel: SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id WHERE cfga.id = :id union all SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.id = cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga2.custom_field_id WHERE cfga.id = :id
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.addFieldToGro: insert into flow.custom_field_group_assignment(custom_field_group_id, custom_field_id, ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id, field_order, created_by_id, schedule_field_type_id) values (:customFieldGroupId, :customFieldId, :ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId, :fieldOrder, :createdById, :scheduleFieldTypeId)
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.moveFieldToOt: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment set custom_field_group_id = :newGroupId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.saveReadOnly: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment set read_only = :cfgaReadOnly, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :cfgaId
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.archiveWhiteL: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment_white_listed_position set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where custom_field_group_assignment_id = :cfgaId

update flow.custom_field_group_assignment_white_listed_position set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where custom_field_group_assignment_id = :cfgaId and position_id not in (:positionIdsUsed)
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.insertWhiteLi: insert into flow.custom_field_group_assignment_white_listed_position(position_id, custom_field_group_assignment_id, created_by_id) select :positionId, :cfgaId, :userId where not exists ( select id from flow.custom_field_group_assignment_white_listed_position where custom_field_group_assignment_id = :cfgaId and position_id = :positionId and archived is not true)
